source: Two plans that break the plan's rules cost the attempt before a word of French is paid for. Plan 1: the measured run of 2026-10-16 (#189) lost g2.2 to two_hander_crowded: a second person on a two-hander's page. Plan 2: the task line the WP-149 B1 read served on g4.1, verbatim (evidence/wp149-confirmation/b1/B1.1.md, day 28).

beats: Monday morning after the party: the learner queues for bread at Mme Diallo's.
The queue goes quiet when the learner reaches the counter.
Mme Diallo slips a free croissant into the bag, «pour Odile».
Lila, behind in the queue, joins in.

change.before: The learner doesn't know how the quartier will look at them after the party.
change.after: They know: the bakery is kind and curious, and Mme Diallo has chosen her side.

content.question: And you, how are you holding up after Saturday?
content.task: Mme Diallo veut savoir comment tu vas depuis samedi.

replies.then: Mme Diallo nods and wraps a second croissant
Mme Diallo comes round the counter

content.hook: The notary's office calls: Thursday, ten o'clock.

chapter.question: How does the quartier treat the learner after the party?
